title: A blood-based four-gene diagnostic signature for Kashin-Beck disease revealed by multi-cohort transcriptomic analysis and machine learning.
authors: Guo, Minghui; Yang, Kunkun; Liu, Shizhang; Sun, Zhengming; Wu, Xueyuan; Li, Xinpei; Wang, Yuchao; Zhu, Xinke; Ling, Ming
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于血液转录组和机器学习构建Kashin-Beck病诊断基因特征，虽涉及转录因子调控注释，但核心是疾病诊断标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Kashin-Beck disease (KBD) is an endemic osteoarthropathy characterized by growth retardation and progressive joint degeneration. However, its systemic molecular features in peripheral blood remain incompletely understood. METHODS: Peripheral blood transcriptomic data from four independent cohorts were analyzed using differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis to identify KBD-associated gene sets. Multiple feature selection strategies and machine learning models were applied to construct and validate a blood-based diagnostic signature across cohorts. Immune cell composition was inferred by computational deconvolution, and transcription factor regulation, pathway enrichment, and genetic association data were integrated for biological interpretation. RESULTS: A four-gene blood signature (C4B, AQP1, HBA2, and ACSL6) was identified, showing stable diagnostic performance across independent blood cohorts and preserved discriminatory capacity in cartilage tissue. Downstream analyses revealed that the diagnostic genes were associated with altered immune cell composition and immune- and metabolism-related pathways in peripheral blood. CONCLUSIONS: This study defines a compact and interpretable blood-based transcriptomic signature for KBD and provides insight into its systemic immune-related molecular context, supporting its potential utility for disease identification and mechanistic investigation.
abstract_zh: 背景：大骨节病（Kashin-Beck disease, KBD）是一种地方性骨关节病，其特征为生长迟缓和进行性关节退变。然而，其在外周血中的系统性分子特征尚未完全明了。方法：利用四个独立队列的外周血转录组数据，通过差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析，识别与大骨节病相关的基因集。采用多种特征选择策略和机器学习模型，跨队列构建并验证基于血液的诊断特征。通过计算去卷积推断免疫细胞组成，并整合转录因子调控、通路富集及遗传关联数据进行生物学解释。结果：识别出一个四基因血液特征（C4B、AQP1、HBA2和ACSL6），在独立血液队列中表现出稳定的诊断性能，并在软骨组织中保持区分能力。下游分析显示，这些诊断基因与外周血中免疫细胞组成改变及免疫和代谢相关通路有关。结论：本研究定义了一个紧凑且可解释的基于血液的转录组特征，用于大骨节病，并揭示其系统性免疫相关分子背景，支持其在疾病识别和机制研究中的潜在应用价值。
